'''2007 European Champions' MPC''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG year-end match-play championship for European players, announced as the "Year Ender MPC: Fight For Virtual Creation" for 17 November 2007 at the Nibelungenquelle in Bensheim, Germany.<ref name="sf-15832-216433">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=216433#p216433 &#91;EUROPE&#93;: Champions' MPC on 17th and 18th November], Tusken84 (Nico Kreidl), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 July 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125033315/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=15832 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Nico Kreidl]] organized it from an idea of [[Chris Menzel]], and the top two players of each 2007 European regional qualified for it.<ref name="sf-15832-216433" /><ref name="sf-15832-216503">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=216503#p216503 &#91;EUROPE&#93;: Champions' MPC on 17th and 18th November], Tusken84 (Nico Kreidl), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (5 July 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125033315/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=15832 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Nibelungenquelle, Bensheim, Germany (announced as "99%" certain)<ref name="sf-15832-216433" />
* '''Dates:''' 17 November 2007; the forum topic was titled "Champions' MPC on 17th and 18th November"<ref name="sf-15832-216433" />
* '''Format:''' match play; at least four to six games for everyone, with a separate side tournament<ref name="sf-15832-216433" />
* '''Entry fee:''' announced as between 7 and 12 euros<ref name="sf-15832-216433" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Nico Kreidl]]<ref name="sf-15832-216433" />

== Organization ==

Kreidl announced the event on 4 July 2007. Menzel had the idea and bought much of the prize support; Kreidl wrote that it would "probably" include a virtual card. Kreidl added that, depending on the number of players, two to four Reflections II Ultra Rare foils would be added to the prizes.<ref name="sf-15832-216433" /> Menzel wrote that the dates had been arranged with the Players Committee and promised large prize support, including a glass trophy, polo shirts, T-shirts and boosters.<ref name="sf-15832-216444">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=216444#p216444 &#91;EUROPE&#93;: Champions' MPC on 17th and 18th November], Shadow 14 (Chris Menzel), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 July 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125033315/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=15832 Internet Archive]</ref>
